source.title: Continental Championship 2022 Announcement (February 2021)
source.content:
We are happy to announce that **Brasilia, Brazil** will be hosting the upcoming **WCA South American Championship in 2022**.


You can view the application documents [here](https://drive.google.com/file/d/19yrkx6hQogL_kvRdlCSscPBoTFkqri6b/view).


Lastly, we would like to remind you that the **WCA Oceania Championship 2022** will have an application period **from March 1st to May 31st 2021** in line with the World Championship 2023 application period.

translation.title: 2022 年大洲锦标赛举办地公告（2021 年 2 月）
translation.content:
我们很高兴宣布，**巴西巴西利亚**将举办 **2022 年 WCA 南美锦标赛**。

申办材料可在[此处](https://drive.google.com/file/d/19yrkx6hQogL_kvRdlCSscPBoTFkqri6b/view)查看。

最后提醒大家，**2022 年 WCA 大洋洲锦标赛**的申办期为 **2021 年 3 月 1 日至 5 月 31 日**，与 2023 年世界锦标赛申办期一致。
